name: Barrow Cairn-Wight
languages: Common plus the languages it knew in life

Traits.name: The Dread of Running Water
Traits.text: When the cairn-wight is subjected to running water, The cairn-wight becomes Frightened of the cairn-wight or force that carried the water against it and flees from it along the swiftest line it can find until the fright ends; nothing else turns the unhurried thing so completely to flight.

Traits.expressedQuote: The cairn-wight becomes Frightened of the cairn-wight or force that carried the water against it and flees from it along the swiftest line it can find until the fright ends

Traits.name: Necrotic Absorption
Traits.text: Whenever the cairn-wight is subjected to Necrotic damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

Traits.name: Magic Resistance
Traits.text: The cairn-wight has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The cairn-wight makes two Slam attacks.

Actions.name: Slam
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 22 (4d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

lore: Bound into its barrow by a curse spoken at burial, the cairn-wight guards its stacked grave-stones and drags the living into the pile to join it.

generation.userConcept: a cairn-wight that cannot be harmed by steel and fears only running water
generation.cite: composition after Flesh Golem (CR 5) — the made thing that cannot be unmade

monsterDescription: a cairn-wight that cannot be harmed by steel and fears only running water
